description: What people wrote under the artist's posted Promo posts, read live from Instagram and YouTube, newest first, each with its comment_id, who wrote it (from_you when the artist's own account did), when, its likes and its first replies. Without post_id: the comments on the latest posted posts, 5 posts at a time (posts_offset for older ones). With post_id: that post's comments page by page (cursor). networks says which connected networks cannot be read and why: Meta refused Audora the permission to read Facebook comments, and TikTok's API has no way to read them. Reply with reply_comment.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

cursor.description: With post_id: next_cursor from the last call, for the next page of its comments.

limit.description: Comments per post, 1–50. Default 20 on one post, 10 each otherwise.

post_id.description: One posted post (post_id from this tool, promo_results or get_campaign).

posts.description: Without post_id: how many posts, 1–10. Default 5.

posts_offset.description: Without post_id: skip this many of the latest posts (next_posts_offset).

name: list_comments
title: Comments on the posts
